propositions: fsck does not currently detect dirty-tree class wedges (tracked deletions, untracked regenerable artifacts, orphaned tmp files, stale locks) that caused recent P0 production wedges
doctor --repair lacks a sanctioned non-destructive repair path for dirty-tree wedges; operators resort to ad-hoc raw git commands
fsck must classify git status porcelain output into three tracker-dirty kinds and report each via distinct JSON findings with paths and counts

doctor --repair must repair dirty-tree findings in two non-reentrant lock windows: first for file mutations (restore deletions, quarantine leftovers), then release lock and invoke reconverge self-locking
doctor --repair must record a backup ref before any mutation and leave class-3 (.tmp-event-*) files untouched for manual triage
file mutations must use sanctioned safe operations (git checkout for restoration, move-to-quarantine for untracked) with zero destructive deletes or lock holds into reconverge
